_comment: Golden wire shape for the NEW read endpoint GET /api/v1/management/licensing/agents?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD (L9; consumed by Platform.Web for L12). PlatformAdminOnly, like /management/system/license*. Unit: licensedAgents = PDR-0003 section C licensed agents, the daily SIMULTANEOUS peak of counted identities (integer count of identities, never seconds or sessions). day = calendar date in dayZone (ISO-8601 date). The deployment figure for the range is the highest daily sum across Customer tenants (deployment.peakLicensedAgents on deployment.peakDay). Nullability: deployment.peakDay is string|null; it is null, and deployment.peakLicensedAgents is 0, when no day in the range is closed (days is then empty and overBand false). Each tenant/day cell is the LATEST revision of that (tenantId, day) row (a correction row has revision > 0); rowHash is that row's hash in its tenant chain (scheme prefix lac1:). license.maxAgents is ADVISORY (license.maxAgentsAdvisory is always true): null or 0 means not declared, and then deployment.overBand is false. overBand is computed server-side as maxAgents > 0 AND peakLicensedAgents > maxAgents; nothing is ever blocked on it. license.* is read once from ILicenseStatus per request (licenseId may be null when no licence is loaded). Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).
